    result = subprocess.run(['python3','./tower_of_hanoi.pyc','moves',json_chunk], capture_output=True, text=True)
    # Print output for debugging
    sys.stdout.write(result.stdout)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

# After all moves, check final status
stat = subprocess.run(['python3','./tower_of_hanoi.pyc','status'], capture_output=True, text=True)
sys.stdout.write(stat.stdout)
